description: This file defines the interface 'LoanAccountDomainService' which declares methods for managing loan transactions, refunds, disbursements, collateral status, delinquency tags, and interest refunds within the loan account domain of the Fineract project.

classes.name: LoanAccountDomainService
classes.description: Interface declaring domain-level operations for loan account management, including transactions, refunds, collateral, delinquency, and interest handling.

methods.name: makeRepayment
methods.description: Creates a repayment transaction for a loan, with options for recovery, holiday validation, and account transfer.

methods.name: makeRefund
methods.description: Processes a refund for a loan, returning the associated transactions.

methods.name: makeDisburseTransaction
methods.description: Handles disbursement of funds for a loan, including loan-to-loan transfers.

methods.name: makeChargePayment
methods.description: Processes a payment towards a specific charge on a loan.

methods.name: makeRefundForActiveLoan
methods.description: Processes a refund for an active loan.

methods.name: updateLoanCollateralStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of loan collateral management set, releasing or releasing collateral.

methods.name: setLoanDelinquencyTag
methods.description: Sets or removes delinquency tags based on loan overdue status.

methods.name: disableStandingInstructionsLinkedToClosedLoan
methods.description: Disables all standing instructions linked to a closed loan.

methods.name: creditBalanceRefund
methods.description: Processes a refund against the credit balance of a loan.

methods.name: makeRefund
methods.description: Creates a refund transaction with schedule and interest considerations.

methods.name: updateAndSavePostDatedChecksForIndividualAccount
methods.description: Updates post-dated checks for an individual loan account.

methods.name: applyInterestRefund
methods.description: Applies an interest refund to a loan.

methods.name: updateAndSaveLoanCollateralTransactionsForIndividualAccounts
methods.description: Updates collateral transactions for individual loan accounts.

methods.name: createManualInterestRefundWithAmount
methods.description: Creates a manual interest refund transaction with a specified amount.
